items.title: Extract experience, education and skills
externalEvidence: GitHub Actions run 42581255959 completed successfully on exact PR head 9a1c46fc9060e30eef58475b6f0f5cdf381ecdc3: Quality gates, production image build (not published), and services/integration/browser suites all passed.

GitHub Actions run 42585568281 completed successfully on exact PR head 8734dae78e83470350b45094da9a57ef5176d644: Quality gates, production image build (not published), and services/integration/browser suites all passed. A subsequent review found a technology-evidence provenance issue and the branch was updated; this run does not validate the later correction.

Review at 8734dae78e83470350b45094da9a57ef5176d644 resolved F1–F5 but found whole-document technology evidence could be mislabeled direct. Follow-up correction at f51b8d8c59ad4a80f39039adb69c36e594be7c80 adds section-scoped direct evidence, document-wide supporting-source fallback, and a regression test; exact-head run 42587143576 passed all three jobs. Independent re-review approved engineering/documentation scope conditional on that CI, while preserving item 4.05 as partial because it did not attest completion of every owner acceptance criterion.

Current local follow-up adds backward-compatible, strict and bounded experienceClaims with source excerpt, explicit title/employer when parseable, dates, description and unverified status. Local domain suite passed 934 tests across 33 files; typecheck passed including 97 canonical test files; format, lint (zero errors), traceability passed. Node runtime is below the project-required Node 24; exact-head hosted CI and independent review remain pending.

Independent exact-head review at 10ee6f6652c102239f3e76c5ab263ba5a67a37fa found two experience provenance issues: employer inference from arbitrary preceding lines and descriptions crossing into subsequent roles. The current follow-up requires same-date employer header evidence, bounds each role excerpt/description at the next role-like header, and adds negative regressions. Domain suite now passes 936 tests across 33 files; full typecheck passes with 97 canonical test files; fresh exact-head hosted CI and independent re-review are pending.

Re-review of 10ee6f6652c102239f3e76c5ab263ba5a67a37fa accepted the role-boundary fix (F2) but found matching dates alone insufficient to establish an employer (F1). The correction now requires an explicit Employer:/Company:/Organization: label on the adjacent same-date line; unlabeled text remains source excerpt only. Added a dated prose line negative test and labeled employer positive test. Focused resume/schema suites pass 103 tests; full typecheck passes. Fresh domain/full gates and exact-head hosted CI/re-review pending.

Owner final acceptance approved item 4.05 at exact implementation head 8d1b3e2a74e5d372d7e98281a6e28871685d672b after confirming the checklist criteria for experience, education, skills, per-role provenance, conservative employer attribution, unverified claims, backward compatibility and regression coverage. Hosted GitHub Actions run 42597590755 passed all required jobs on that exact SHA. This documentation status update records that acceptance; credential authenticity remains explicitly unverified.

Final exact-head ChatGPT review approved the documentation/audit sync at PR #72 head d88dad558af82c05e4ad27585c2bbd20c34386ea after Actions run 42819440306 passed all three required jobs. PR #72 merged to dev as 444ed255cb02a72fa543c5fdf9b65b8151c9d494; post-merge dev run 42821920705 passed Quality gates and Services/integration/browser suites, with the production image build skipped for the push event. Employer and education authenticity remain unverified.

items.gap: Candidates can read extracted text and preview a profile draft, but there is no full document preview, accessible rendered-document navigation, or acceptance test for resume review behavior.

items.title: Multiple resume versions
items.gap: Multiple uploads can be listed; target-role labels, explicit version lineage, role-aware selection and corresponding candidate workflow are absent.

items.title: Manual correction of parsed information
items.gap: Parsed fields can seed an editable profile draft, but the extracted resume text is read-only and there is no per-field correction/acceptance workflow tied to the parsed result.

items.title: Profile synchronization
items.gap: No explicit profile synchronization action/version/conflict policy exists for parsed resume data; manual profile-form population is not synchronization.
